summary: SEO overhaul retest ROUND 2 — ALL CASES PASS. The fix of removing helmet-managed tags from public/index.html worked. Case 1 PASS: every public route (/, /services, /booking, /staff, /contact, /faq, /blog, /sitemap, /blog/<slug>) now has exactly ONE meta[name=description], ONE link[rel=canonical] (href matches current route on https://www.saskstartupsolutions.ca), ONE meta[name=robots], and ONE og:title. Case 2 PASS: /admin and /portal each expose exactly ONE meta[name=robots] with content 'noindex, nofollow'. Case 3 PASS: initial load of / pushes exactly 1 page_view to window.dataLayer; SPA nav to /contact pushes exactly 1 more (total 2); FAQ page shows capitalized answers and FAQPage JSON-LD (alongside LocalBusiness); home renders; blog post renders with full article h1 'Saskatchewan Business Registration: A Guide to Incorporation, Registry Updates and Annual Returns'. Case 4 PASS: view-source of / contains gtag config('G-03VN7HB92G') exactly once, LocalBusiness JSON-LD once, and the noscript content block.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/public/index.html is now minimal and correct — only non-per-route tags remain (title, og:type, og:site_name, og:image dims/alt, og:locale, twitter:card, favicons, GA4 gtag with send_page_view:false, LocalBusiness JSON-LD, noscript). react-helmet-async (Seo.jsx) is the single source of truth for per-route meta.
AnalyticsTracker useRef guard confirmed: no duplicate page_view on initial render; SPA navigations push exactly one page_view each.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 SEO retest cases PASS across 11 routes)

test_credentials: Not used — all tested routes are public.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO duplication regression fully resolved. If future routes/pages are added, repeat the per-route inspection: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('meta[name=description], link[rel=canonical], meta[name=robots], meta[property="og:title"]')) — each count must be exactly 1, canonical href must match route on https://www.saskstartupsolutions.ca, and /admin + /portal robots must be 'noindex, nofollow'.
rca of the issue: Root cause of previous failures was that react-helmet-async@3.0.0 does not adopt pre-rendered static head tags (the data-rh='true' attribute is write-only for Helmet, not read-in during client mount). Fix applied by main agent: physically removed the per-route tags (description/robots/canonical/og:title/og:description/og:url/og:image/twitter:title/description/image) from public/index.html so Helmet-rendered copies are the sole occurrences. Verified.
